u0: Search phase: the matching key has not yet been seen. Explore the left-column rooms and hallway, turning and moving so the key enters the clear 7x7 view (opening unlocked doors with toggle if they block the view). Objective: make key_found true to advance to u1.
u1: The key is in view but not yet held. Navigate to the key's cell and pick it up with the empty hand. Objective: make has_matching_key true to advance to u2; dropping back to u0 is not possible since key_found is latched.
u2: Carrying the matching key, the locked door guarding the target room is still closed. Locate the locked door in the right-column target room's left wall and toggle it open. Objective: make target_door_open true to advance to u3. If the key is dropped, fall back to u1.
u3: The target door is open but the agent has not yet entered the target room. Move through the doorway into the 6x6 target room block (the doorway counts as inside). Objective: make target_room_entered true to advance to u4. If the door is toggled shut, fall back to u2.
u4: Inside the target room, the mission ball has not been picked up yet (hands still hold the key). Drop the key, then pick up the mission ball; the pickup must occur while the target door remains open. Objective: make target_picked_up & target_door_open hold to reach final state u5. If the door is not open, fall back to u3.
u5: Final state: the mission ball has been picked up with the target door open. This is the accepting terminal state; keep the door open for the last step. If the door were to be shut, fall back to u4, but ideally the episode ends here.
